name: Shaalbim
brief: Town in Dan, home of David's mighty men
short: Shaalbim, also called Shaalabbin, was a town allotted to the tribe of Dan (<ref="Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35">Josh. 19:42; Judg. 1:35</ref>) and the hometown of some of David's mighty men (<ref="2Sam. 23:32; 1Chr. 11:33">2Sam. 23:32; 1Chr. 11:33</ref>). It was also a town under Solomon's administration (<ref="1Ki. 4:9">1Ki. 4:9</ref>).
